# Somatic SNVs/InDels

```{r snv_indel_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

vstats_pdf <- pcg_report$content$snv_indel$vstats
snv_pdf <- pcg_report$content$snv_indel$callset$variant
oncogenic_pdf <- if ("ONCOGENICITY" %in% colnames(snv_pdf)) {
  snv_pdf |>
    dplyr::filter(
      tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(.data$ONCOGENICITY, "_", " ")) %in%
        c("oncogenic", "likely oncogenic"))
} else snv_pdf[0, , drop = FALSE]
## ranked by actionability tier (Tier 1 first; no tier last), then by
## oncogenicity score (highest first)
if (NROW(oncogenic_pdf) > 0) {
  tier_rank <- if ("ACTIONABILITY_TIER" %in% colnames(oncogenic_pdf))
    suppressWarnings(as.integer(oncogenic_pdf$ACTIONABILITY_TIER)) else
      rep(NA_integer_, NROW(oncogenic_pdf))
  score <- if ("ONCOGENICITY_SCORE" %in% colnames(oncogenic_pdf))
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(oncogenic_pdf$ONCOGENICITY_SCORE)) else
      rep(NA_real_, NROW(oncogenic_pdf))
  oncogenic_pdf <- oncogenic_pdf[order(
    dplyr::coalesce(tier_rank, 99L), -dplyr::coalesce(score, -Inf)), ,
    drop = FALSE]
}
n_oncogenic_pdf <- NROW(oncogenic_pdf)
```

## Variant statistics

```{r snv_indel_stats_kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

stat_or_na <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "N/A" else as.character(x)
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_kpi_row(list(
  list(title = "Somatic variants (total)", value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var)),
  list(title = "SNVs", value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var_snv)),
  list(title = "InDels", value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var_indel)),
  list(title = "Protein-coding variants",
       value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var_coding)))))
```

```{r snv_indel_stats_plots}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(vstats_pdf$n_var > 0)
#| fig-width: 3.4
#| fig-height: 1.8
#| layout-ncol: 2

pdf_plot_varstats <- pcgrr:::pdf_plot_varstats(pcg_report)
for (p in pdf_plot_varstats) print(p)
```

## Oncogenic and likely oncogenic variants {#pcgr-oncogenic-variants}

```{r oncogenic_intro}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat("The oncogenicity of somatic SNVs/InDels is classified through an ",
    "implementation of the ClinGen/CGC/VICC standard operating procedure ",
    "[@Horak2022-uh]: evidence _for_ and _against_ an oncogenic nature of a given variant is ",
    "aggregated into an overall oncogenicity score, which determines its ",
    "classification (see *Appendix: Documentation - Variant oncogenicity ",
    "classification*). Listed below are the variants classified as ",
    "oncogenic or likely oncogenic (**n = ", n_oncogenic_pdf, "**), ranked by ",
    "actionability tier (AMP/ASCO/CAP) [@Li2017-ew], then by oncogenicity ",
    "score.\n\n",
    sep = "")
```

```{r oncogenic_table}

#| eval: !expr n_oncogenic_pdf > 0

## actionable or not)
oncogenic_pdf |>
  pcgrr:::pdf_table_variants(color = report_color, variant_class = FALSE)
```


## Variant filtering {#pcgr-variant-filtering}

```{r snv_indel_filtering_setup}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

filt_pdf <- pcgrr:::filtering_summary(pcg_report)
fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
if (!is.na(filt_pdf$n_input)) {
  cat("Of **n = ", fmt_n(filt_pdf$n_input), "** somatic SNVs/InDels in the ",
      "input VCF, **n = ", fmt_n(filt_pdf$n_reported), "** were retained ",
      "after filtering and are considered in this report",
      if (filt_pdf$tumor_only) " (depth/allelic support filtering, then ",
      if (filt_pdf$tumor_only) "germline filtering of the tumor-only input)",
      ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat("### Depth and allelic support\n\n")
if (NROW(filt_pdf$read_support) == 0) {
  cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(kind = "empty", paste0(
    "No thresholds for sequencing depth or allelic support were set - no ",
    "variants were filtered on depth/allelic support."),
    title = "Not applied"))
} else {
  cat("Variants were filtered on sequencing depth (DP), allelic fraction ",
      "(AF) and allelic depth (AD) in the tumor",
      if (!filt_pdf$tumor_only) " and control", " sample",
      if (!filt_pdf$tumor_only) "s", ", in the order listed.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_read_support}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr NROW(filt_pdf$read_support) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_read_support(filt_pdf$read_support, color = report_color)
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_read_support_warning}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr NROW(filt_pdf$read_support_removed) > 0
lbl <- pcgrr:::filtered_variant_labels(filt_pdf$read_support_removed)
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
  "The following actionable variants (Tier 1/2) or mutation hotspots did ",
  "not pass the depth/allelic support thresholds and are not considered ",
  "in this report - review them and/or the filtering settings:\n\n",
  paste0("- ", lbl, collapse = "\n")),
  title = "Actionable variants removed by filtering", kind = "warning"))
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_germline}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr filt_pdf$tumor_only
cat("### Germline filtering (tumor-only)\n\n")
cat("Without a matched control sample, likely germline variants are ",
    "excluded from the tumor-only input based on the following settings:",
    "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(pcgrr:::tumor_only_settings_markdown(filt_pdf$tumor_only_settings), "\n")
if (NROW(filt_pdf$germline) > 0) {
  cat("*Step 1 - germline filters*: classification of the variants (n = ",
      fmt_n(sum(filt_pdf$germline$N)), ") - variants matching more than one ",
      "germline filter are counted as *MULTIPLE FILTERS*:\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_germline_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr filt_pdf$tumor_only && NROW(filt_pdf$germline) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_filter_shares(
  filt_pdf$germline, settings = filt_pdf$tumor_only_settings,
  color = report_color)
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_exonic}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr filt_pdf$tumor_only && NROW(filt_pdf$exonic) > 0
cat("\n*Step 2 - exonic status*: classification of the remaining somatic ",
    "variants (n = ", fmt_n(sum(filt_pdf$exonic$N)), ") - non-exonic ",
    "variants are excluded:\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_exonic_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr filt_pdf$tumor_only && NROW(filt_pdf$exonic) > 0
pcgrr:::pdf_table_filter_shares(filt_pdf$exonic, color = report_color)
```

```{r snv_indel_filtering_germline_warning}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr NROW(filt_pdf$germline_removed) > 0
lbl <- pcgrr:::filtered_variant_labels(filt_pdf$germline_removed)
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_note(paste0(
  "The following actionable variants (Tier 1/2) were filtered as likely ",
  "germline events and are not considered in this report - germline status ",
  "should be verified (e.g. with a matched control sample):\n\n",
  paste0("- ", lbl, collapse = "\n")),
  title = "Actionable variants filtered as likely germline", kind = "warning"))
```
